subject: reasoning
question: If the father of Swati is the maternal grandfather of Divya, who is the daughter of Manya, then how is Manya's husband's father related to Divya?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/FyD9L3PCPvZsHa5nynlMPf_fzf_aXK9tKopSaDWxBYVwFRo-6fzjiv7HQG28YUhFJ0nLGj9_hEV_JqW5NQsWS_FX2dnhd3UTkTZ5DE4dKFyqgfFDku2-8QBz2pL7YIeD6iwR5lii] 

 
• Father of Swati is the maternal grandfather of Divya. So, there have two possibilities.

**​Case(1):** Swati can the mother of Divya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c7120cac2597c4d337ffd7d3789dfbb45c2557abe54cc0b35f38f228be95e0a.png] 

**Case(2): ** Swati's sister can the mother of Divya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4997113da2a696105d7cdb71360c72e1145597d79ec5e821c49c6396e493939.png] 

 
• Father of Swati is the maternal grandfather of Divya, who is the daughter of Manya. That means Divya is daughter of Manya. Manya is either father or mother of Divya.

**Case(1):**

Manya is the father of Divya i.e Manya is married to Swati.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/706b31d9aec1ad0b56f54f28f49219418a57cc5d91885e2661546a78b22ac2c5.png] 

**Case(2a):** Manya is father of Divya i.e Manya is married to Swati's sister.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8405ffe99aad06e5527d67a7c772eadfcad033cfc9c1dea228e59ab5d8c42a21.png] 

**Case(2b): ** Manya is mother of Divya i.e Manya is the sister of swati.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f02da7a0bd2f35823ec76034a592ccc11cffe928331d7f826195d777d728fde6.png] ​

As it is asked in the question that how is Manya's husband's father related to Divya 

⇒ Here "Manya's husband" clarify that Manya is a female. So, both case(1) and case (2a) is eliminated.

So, according to the question asked the family tree is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6a0b9bfbefc570d3c45a8e8c3c64fcbaee4998bbb2d1776a311c0aa205c22c3.png] 

Cleary, Manya's husband's father is the paternal grandfather of Divya.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Paternal grandfather"**.
